svg.title: BoardGamesWithQuests — finalized product UI mockup
svg.desc: Design mockup showing a playable chess view with generic actions and history, a configurable participant lobby, and a game-definition editor. This is a normative design reference, not a screenshot or evidence of working software.
svg.text: Product UI reference · desktop view, lobby & configuration editor
Players join using a private link
A game starts only when the selected number of seats is filled.
Design language: responsive, game-neutral SVG scene • typed actions • server-authoritative state • private multiplayer
